name: admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: administrative_distance
desc: Set the administrative distance for HMM. - Range: `1`-`255`

name: anycast_mac
desc: Anycast Gateway MAC address.

name: control
desc: The control state. - Choices: `stateful-ha`

name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: duplicate_host_detection_moves
desc: User Setting to mark a host as duplicate if it does ddHmmoves number of moves. - Range: `1`-`1000`

name: duplicate_host_detection_seconds
desc: User Setting to mark a host as duplicate if it does ddHmmoves moves in ddHnsecs seconds. - Range: `2`-`36000`

name: duplicate_host_recovery_count
desc: Number of times (dhrcount) to periodically check if a Duplicate marked Host is no longer duplicate. - Range: `1`-`3000`

name: duplicate_host_recovery_timeout
desc: User Setting to periodically (dhrtimeout seconds) check if a Duplicate marked Host is no longer duplicate. - Range: `30`-`36000`

name: evpn_admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: evpn_control
desc: The control state. - Choices: `stateful-ha`

name: instance_admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: interfaces
desc: List of HMM Fabric Forwarding interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `vlan10`.

name: interfaces[*].admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: interfaces[*].description
desc: Description.

name: interfaces[*].mode
desc: HMM Fabric Forwarding mode information for the interface. - Choices: `standard`, `anycastGW`, `proxyGW`

name: interfaces[*].proxy
desc: Enable Anycast Gateway with proxy. - Minimum NX-OS version: `10.6(3)`

name: limit_vlan_mac
desc: This is to limit the number of hosts learnt by HMM in the same subnet with same MAC information. - Range: `5`-`4096`

name: selective_host_probe
desc: When set to True, host mobility will be triggered when a remote host route exists irrespective of the sequence id. - Choices: `no`, `yes`
